patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,6 +1,49 @@
-class PhoneNumber:
-    def __init__(self, number: str):
-        pass
-
-    def pretty(self) -> str:
-        pass
+import re
+
+
+class PhoneNumber:
+    def __init__(self, number: str):
+        # Remove all non-digit characters
+        cleaned = re.sub(r'[^\d]', '', number)
+        
+        # Check for invalid characters (letters or punctuation that wasn't removed)
+        if re.search(r'[a-zA-Z]', number):
+            raise ValueError("letters not permitted")
+        if re.search(r'[^\d\s\(\)\-\+\.]', number):
+            raise ValueError("punctuations not permitted")
+            
+        # Check length
+        if len(cleaned) < 10:
+            raise ValueError("must not be fewer than 10 digits")
+        if len(cleaned) > 11:
+            raise ValueError("must not be greater than 11 digits")
+            
+        # Handle 11-digit numbers
+        if len(cleaned) == 11:
+            if cleaned[0] != '1':
+                raise ValueError("11 digits must start with 1")
+            cleaned = cleaned[1:]  # Remove the country code
+            
+        # At this point, we should have exactly 10 digits
+        if len(cleaned) != 10:
+            raise ValueError("must not be fewer than 10 digits")
+            
+        # Validate area code (first 3 digits)
+        if cleaned[0] == '0':
+            raise ValueError("area code cannot start with zero")
+        if cleaned[0] == '1':
+            raise ValueError("area code cannot start with one")
+            
+        # Validate exchange code (next 3 digits)
+        if cleaned[3] == '0':
+            raise ValueError("exchange code cannot start with zero")
+        if cleaned[3] == '1':
+            raise ValueError("exchange code cannot start with one")
+            
+        self.number = cleaned
+        self.area_code = cleaned[:3]
+        self.exchange = cleaned[3:6]
+        self.subscriber = cleaned[6:]
+
+    def pretty(self) -> str:
+        return f"({self.area_code})-{self.exchange}-{self.subscriber}"
